title: The Marriage of Crows
text: The quarrels between the Houses have grown teeth. The Court of the Pact sends black-feathered heralds to every Seat with the same demand: bind yourselves by blood, or be bound. They have chosen which House must answer first.

options.label: Agree to a marriage pact with another House, and bind yourselves by blood.

outcomes.text: The vows are said in the cathedral at midnight, as the old law wants. The crows sit on every pew and watch.
The vows are said, and in the morning both brides wake with a thumbprint of ash on their brows.

options.label: Pay the Court a dowry in place of a bride, and keep your blood your own.

outcomes.text: The heralds count the coin twice and leave a black feather on your table.

options.label: Refuse the Court. No House binds yours.

outcomes.text: The heralds leave without a word. In every Seat, someone starts sharpening something.
